Varun Tiwari  
+972-54-321-0987 | varuntiwari@example.com | Tel Aviv, Israel  

A seasoned mobile development professional with a focus on cross-platform solutions and scalable architecture. Over the past six years, I’ve led teams to deliver high-impact applications for enterprise clients, emphasizing robust UI/UX design, CI/CD integration, and seamless API interactions. My work spans both Android and iOS ecosystems, with a growing emphasis on Flutter for cross-platform efficiency.  

Senior Mobile Developer  
NexGen Mobility Solutions | 2021–present  
Led the development of a flagship enterprise app for a logistics client, reducing onboarding time by 40% through Flutter-based cross-platform implementation. Spearheaded the integration of CI/CD pipelines, which cut deployment cycles by 30% and improved release reliability. Collaborated with backend teams to refine REST API endpoints, resulting in a 25% reduction in API call latency. Mentored junior developers on best practices for Kotlin and unit testing, contributing to a 15% improvement in code quality metrics.  

Mobile Development Lead  
InnovateX Labs | 2019–2021  
Directed the migration of a legacy Android app to a modular architecture, increasing maintainability and enabling parallel development across features. Designed and implemented test automation frameworks using Espresso and UI Automator, reducing manual testing hours by 50%. Orchestrated the deployment of apps to the App Store, achieving a 98% success rate in submission processes.  

Junior Mobile Developer  
TechNova Innovations | 2018–2019  
Contributed to the development of a B2B Android app, focusing on performance optimization and user flow improvements. Collaborated on REST API design for data synchronization, ensuring secure and efficient backend communication.  

Technical Skills  
- **Flutter**: Developed cross-platform apps for enterprise clients, with a focus on performance tuning and state management.  
- **Test automation**: Implemented Espresso and UI Automator frameworks to streamline QA processes and reduce regression risks.  
- **Android development**: Owned the architecture of multiple Android apps, optimizing resource management and improving app stability.  
- **App Store deployment**: Managed submission workflows for over 15 apps, ensuring compliance with platform guidelines and rapid approval cycles.  
- **Kotlin (Android)**: Refactored legacy codebases to modern Kotlin standards, improving readability and reducing technical debt.  
- **Mobile CI/CD**: Automated build and deployment pipelines, reducing release cycles and enhancing collaboration between teams.  
- **REST API design**: Architected scalable APIs for data exchange, ensuring secure and efficient communication between frontend and backend systems.  
- **React Native**: Built modular components for a cross-platform app, balancing performance with developer productivity.  
- **Swift**: Developed iOS-specific features for a flagship app, focusing on memory optimization and user experience.  
- **TypeScript**: Leveraged type safety in frontend libraries to minimize runtime errors and improve code maintainability.  
- **Unit testing**: Integrated unit tests into development workflows, achieving 85% code coverage for core modules.  
- **Mobile UI/UX**: Designed intuitive interfaces for enterprise apps, mentoring junior designers and ensuring alignment with user needs.  
- **iOS development**: Engineered core features for iOS apps, contributing to architecture decisions and ensuring platform-specific optimizations.
